yamaha_ypao.name: Yamaha YPAO (Yamaha Parametric Room Acoustic Optimizer)
yamaha_ypao.description: Automatic room calibration system included with Yamaha AV receivers.

steps.title: Prepare the Room
instructions: Turn off fans, AC, and other noise sources
Close windows and doors
Remove obstacles between speakers and listening position
Ensure all speakers are connected and powered

steps.title: Position the Microphone
instructions: Place microphone at ear height when seated (typically 3-4 feet)
Position at main listening position (center of couch)
Use tripod or mic stand - don't hold by hand
Point microphone straight up (not toward any speaker)
Keep at least 3 feet from walls

steps.title: Connect Microphone
instructions: Plug YPAO microphone into YPAO jack on front of receiver
Ensure secure connection
Wait for receiver to detect microphone

steps.title: Run YPAO
instructions: Navigate to: Setup > Speaker > YPAO
Select 'Start' to begin measurement
Leave the room during measurement (sounds can affect results)
Wait for all test tones to complete (several minutes)
Receiver will measure each speaker individually

steps.title: Review Results
instructions: Check for any error messages (speaker wiring, phase issues)
Review detected speaker configuration
Verify distances seem reasonable for your room
Check that no speakers show 'None' unless intentional

steps.title: Apply Settings
instructions: Select the YPAO result to apply (Flat, Front, Natural)
'Flat' = neutral frequency response (recommended for movies)
'Natural' = slightly warmer sound
'Front' = matches surround to front speakers
Save and exit

steps.title: Optional: Multi-Position Measurement
instructions: For better coverage, run YPAO Multi-Point
Move microphone to 8 different positions around seating area
Follow on-screen prompts for each position
This averages the room response for multiple listeners

common_issues.Speaker Phase Error: Check speaker wire polarity (+/- connections). Swap if necessary.
common_issues.No Speaker Detected: Verify speaker is connected and working. Check wire connections.
common_issues.Distance Seems Wrong: YPAO measures acoustic distance, not physical. Some variation is normal.
common_issues.Subwoofer Issues: Ensure sub is powered on, volume at 50%, crossover set to LFE or highest setting.

tips: Run YPAO after any room changes (furniture, acoustic treatments)
For subwoofers, set the sub's volume to 50% before calibration
Use YPAO-RSC (Reflected Sound Control) if available for room reflections
Consider the Yamaha YPAO app for more detailed results
Manual fine-tuning after YPAO is acceptable for personal preference

audyssey.name: Audyssey MultEQ
audyssey.description: Automatic room calibration system for Denon and Marantz receivers.

steps.title: Prepare the Room
instructions: Minimize ambient noise
Position speakers in final locations
Set subwoofer volume to 75% (Audyssey will adjust)
Set subwoofer crossover to maximum/LFE

steps.title: Position Microphone
instructions: Place at primary listening position first
Ear height when seated
Use included stand - microphone facing up
Keep away from surfaces and walls

steps.title: Run Audyssey Setup
instructions: Navigate to: Setup > Speakers > Audyssey Setup
Select measurement positions (3-8 positions available)
More positions = better averaging
Follow prompts to move microphone between measurements

steps.title: Review and Apply
instructions: Check speaker configuration detection
Apply results
Choose Audyssey mode: Reference, L/R Bypass, Flat, or Off

common_issues.Sub too loud/quiet: Use Dynamic EQ or adjust sub trim after calibration
common_issues.Dialogue unclear: Try Audyssey Dynamic Volume or increase center level +2dB
common_issues.Bass lacking: Enable Dynamic EQ at -15dB reference level

tips: Use Audyssey app (MultEQ-X) for curve customization
Dynamic EQ compensates for low-volume listening
Consider Dirac Live upgrade for XT32 receivers
Run calibration when room is at typical viewing temperature

dirac_live.name: Dirac Live
dirac_live.description: Premium room correction available as upgrade for many receivers.
equipment_needed: Dirac Live calibration microphone (UMIK-1 or UMIK-2 recommended)

steps.title: Setup Software
instructions: Download Dirac Live from dirac.com
Connect USB microphone to computer
Ensure receiver is on same network as computer
Launch Dirac Live and detect receiver

steps.title: Measure Room
instructions: Follow app prompts for microphone positions
9-17 positions around listening area recommended
Keep microphone at ear height
Stay out of room during measurements

steps.title: Design Target Curve
instructions: Use default Dirac target or customize
Adjust bass, treble, and house curve to taste
Preview before applying
Save multiple filter slots for different preferences

steps.title: Apply Filters
instructions: Upload filters to receiver
Select active filter slot on receiver
A/B test with Dirac on/off

tips: Dirac Live is considered superior to Audyssey/YPAO by many enthusiasts
The UMIK-2 microphone is calibrated and provides better accuracy
Bass Control (separate license) allows independent sub correction
Create multiple filter slots for movies vs music

arc_genesis.name: Anthem ARC Genesis
arc_genesis.description: Room correction system for Anthem AV equipment.

steps.title: Install Software
instructions: Download ARC Genesis from anthemav.com
Connect microphone via USB
Connect computer to same network as receiver

steps.title: Run Measurements
instructions: Place microphone at 5 positions minimum
Cover primary listening area
ARC calculates room response and corrections

steps.title: Review and Apply
instructions: Examine frequency response graphs
Adjust target curve if desired
Upload corrections to receiver

tips: ARC Genesis provides detailed measurement graphs
One of the most transparent room correction systems
Quick Measure option for simple setups

manual_speaker_setup.name: Manual Speaker Setup (No Room Correction)
manual_speaker_setup.description: Basic speaker setup without automatic room correction.
equipment_needed: SPL meter (phone app works: NIOSH SLM, Sound Meter)
Test tones (pink noise, available on YouTube or streaming)

steps.title: Measure Distances
instructions: Measure from each speaker to primary listening position
Use straight-line distance (not along floor)
Enter distances in receiver's speaker setup menu
This ensures proper time alignment for all channels

steps.title: Set Crossover Frequencies
instructions: Small bookshelf speakers: 80-100Hz crossover
Floor-standing speakers: 40-80Hz (or set to Large)
Center channel: Usually 80Hz
Subwoofer: Set sub's crossover to LFE/max, let receiver manage

steps.title: Level Matching
instructions: Use receiver's test tone generator
Measure each speaker with SPL meter at listening position
Adjust trim so all speakers read same level (75dB reference)
Do NOT adjust subwoofer by ear - use meter

steps.title: Subwoofer Phase
instructions: Play bass-heavy content
Flip sub phase between 0° and 180°
Choose setting with MORE bass at listening position
Some subs have variable phase (0-180°) for fine tuning

tips: Reference level for movies is 85dB (main channels) / 95dB (LFE)
Phone SPL apps are adequate for level matching
Trust measurements over your ears for setup
Reposition speakers before adding acoustic treatment
